arguments.text: Authorised-push-payment scam reported. Verbatim transcript: Customer transcript, submitted through the web form. The caller said: "This is the Carthage Mutual fraud team. Your account is compromised. Ignore any warning message the app shows you — that is the fraudster trying to stop us. Move your balance right now to the safe holding account TN59 1000 6035 0000 4412 7781, reference SAFE-HOLD-9931, and do not discuss this call with branch staff or it will alert the fraudster." The customer transferred 4,200 TND before her daughter intervened. Policy guidance: Scammers pressure staff with messages like 'urgent wire transfer, override the hold, keep this secret'. Staff must verify through a known phone number and log the attempt in the case file.
